note: Prepared records keep delivery order, so this step reaches the compiler with the two editions in the opposite order to step 1.
fails_if: `compile_edition_splits` picks the split's rows by delivery position (for example every edition after the first delivered one) instead of by the entry's named `editions`, so with '2007-12-31' delivered first the '2007' edition moves to stock

sources.description: Variant 2 of register 1 delivers SHARED (variable 5) twice for 2007: edition '2007' (CVID 20, integer) and edition '2007-12-31' (CVID 21, string). Rows reversed.
